decisions.reason: The accelerator program costs little to keep and still shows on the home page, so it is a cheap option that builds the partner network and is worth holding while its value is still uncertain.
The CO2-negative bitumen binder is a flagship with high but unresolved upside, and a page of its own costs little to maintain, so the option should be held while R&D and market uncertainty play out.

The infectious waste plant is a flagship built in partnership with ERMAFA that sits close to the core offer and is presented consistently in both years, so its value looks increasingly likely to be realized.
